causal_boundary.not_supported: ScienceWorld does not freeze retrieved item identity per decision, and TAG changes multiple control stages (routing, acceptance/rollback, budget, and the fit-selected policy). Therefore the ScienceWorld result is not a single-variable receiver-side applicability-only intervention. The paper's exact fixed-retrieval replay is reported for ASDiv/MultiArith, not ScienceWorld.
causal_boundary.supported: With a memory bank frozen before test and the same Qwen3-8B/prompt-memory substrate, explicit per-step memory-use control and rollback improve the reported ScienceWorld risk/recovery profile relative to fixed-budget exposure.

observations.claim: TAG formalizes applicability separately from retrieval exposure: a baseline action is decoded first; low-confidence states route to memory; the memory-conditioned proposal overrides the baseline only if it clears a confidence margin and deterministic guards, otherwise the system rolls back to the baseline action.

For agents, memory banks are built from train/fit resources and frozen before test. ScienceWorld uses 150 error-recovery/solution-fragment entries, Qwen3-8B, 600 pooled paired evaluations across 3 seeds, and all policy thresholds/budgets are frozen before test reporting.

Against fixed-budget retrieval on ScienceWorld, fixed-budget reports -0.2 pp accuracy, 3 helps/5 hurts, harmful-acceptance rate 0.213, left-tail-risk metric -12.18, call delta -1.24, trajectory recovery 0.352; TAG reports +0.2 pp, 1 help/0 hurts, HAR 0.047, LTR -2.73, call delta -0.91, trajectory recovery 0.483.
The paper explicitly states that fixed-budget and TAG are direct training-free comparators under the same checkpoint and prompt-memory substrate; test-time bank membership is frozen.

Separate fixed-retrieval counterfactual replay freezes retrieved identity and removes retrieval-drift bias, but the quantitative fixed-identity analysis is on ASDiv/MultiArith; on ASDiv target-hit rows repair-minus-corrupt is +0.0571 with 14 helps/8 hurts across 105 rows and one-sided randomization interaction p=0.0022.

protocol_implication: Strongly corroborates RETRIEVAL_IS_NOT_ACTION_AUTHORITY and legal rollback/empty-use semantics in a scientific agent benchmark. It also illustrates why handoff evidence must distinguish fixed bank identity, fixed retrieved identity, and fixed application policy rather than using 'same memory' as one undifferentiated claim.

source.title: A Control Architecture for Training-Free Memory Use
